x: Mile: 1 Craxton (P.); 3 Mowatt (P.); 5 Bruce. 4 mins. 59 secs. Long Jump: 2 Adie, 17ft. 7 ins.; 3 Fleming, 17 ft. 5 ins. Discus: 3 Adie, 88 ft. 4 ins.; 5 Fleming, 71 ft. 8½ ins.

Don Adie was the other Belgravian in this race, and whilst he did not reach the final, showed promise. The next event, the 100 yards, was expected to be won by Grieve, but our two representatives were expected to show up well.
